summary: Intrusion Inc. filed an 8-K disclosing a warrant inducement program approved by its board on August 14, 2026. The company offered holders of existing warrants (3,198,085 shares, weighted average exercise price ~$3.26) the chance to exercise at a reduced price of $0.795 per share during an August 17-28, 2026 effective period. Each participating holder receives a new warrant (exercise price $0.67, exercisable after six months and one day, five-year term) per share purchased. The program complies with Nasdaq rules; the inducement price includes $0.125 per new warrant. This is a capital-raising tactic to boost equity, not a typical special situation. Watch for shareholder dilution and Nasdaq compliance.
